items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: I used to always feature this number, Peggy O'Neill.

ctx.x: You used to play waltzes, too?
Oh, yes. Yes, indeed. I used to play all those numbers. I used to always feature this number, Peggy O'Neill. I liked it. Oh, yeah. Peggy O'Neill.
The shardest, he played, tell you how he played waltzes.
